turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Hi, thanks for coming in today. What's been going on for you lately?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It's been...fine, I guess. I mean, I've been getting by, but it feels like I'm just barely keeping my head above water. I started this new project at work and I'm really interested in it, but I just can't seem to focus on it for more than like 20 minutes before I get distracted by something else. Like, I'll be in the middle of a meeting and I'll start thinking about what I need to pick up from the grocery store on the way home. (pauses) Oh, and have you seen that new coffee shop downtown? I've been meaning to try it out...

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Sounds like you have a lot on your plate right now. Is there anything else that's been bothering you?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (sighs) Yeah, it's just...I feel like I'm always forgetting something. Like, I'll have to write down reminders on my phone and even then I still manage to forget. And it's not just little things either, it's like...important stuff too. Like, I was supposed to fill out that form for my insurance and I just completely spaced on it. (pauses, looks around the room) Do they have a good coffee machine in this building?

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Is there anything I can do to help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (shrugs) I don't know...I just feel like I'm not good at this "adulting" thing. I mean, my friends seem to have it all together, they're always on top of their finances and their schedules and stuff. And I'm just over here trying to remember to pay my bills on time. (laughs awkwardly) It's just really frustrating, you know? (pauses, looks down) Oh, wait, I just thought of something I need to do. I need to call my sister back...

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It sounds like you could use some help getting organized. Is there any particular area that you'd like to focus on first?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (frowns) I've tried, you know? I've tried using planners and apps and all that, but it just doesn't stick. I mean, I'll use them for like a week and then I just lose track again. (sighs) I don't know, maybe it's just me. I've tried setting up this super elaborate system with folders and labels and all that, but it just ends up looking like a mess after a week. (pauses) You know, I just thought of something that's been driving me crazy...I need to return that shirt I bought last month...

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: That sounds like a good place to start. Is there anything else that you need help with?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (fidgets) Oh, yeah...I guess it's just...I feel like I'm always disappointing people, you know? Like, my boss is always on my case about meeting deadlines and my friends are always like "where have you been?" And I'm just like...I don't know, I'll try to do better, but it's just hard. (looks down, fidgets with hands) And sometimes I feel like it's not even my fault, you know? Like, I'll be doing okay and then something will just come up and I'll get sidetracked. (pauses, looks up) Do you have any paper clips? I just need to remember to pick some up...

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Is there anything else that I can do to help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (shrugs) I don't know...I just feel like I'm a lost cause, you know? Like, I'm just not wired the same way as everyone else. (pauses, looks around the room) You know, I've been thinking about going back to school, but I don't know if I could even handle that. I mean, I had trouble in school when I was a kid... (trails off) Oh, wait, what was the question again?

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Is there anything else that you need help with?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (sighs) Yeah...I guess it's just...I've always felt like I'm not living up to my potential, you know? Like, I'm not doing what I'm capable of doing. And it's hard to explain, but... (pauses, looks down) I feel like I'm just barely scraping by, and it's not just about the external stuff, it's about how I feel about myself, too. (looks up, eyes welling up) Sorry, I don't know why I'm getting emotional...

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It's okay. Is there anything else that I can do to help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (wiping away a tear) No, I think that's it. Just...just talking about this is helping, I guess. (pauses, takes a deep breath) Oh, and can you tell me what time it is? I have to be somewhere soon... (looks around the room, seemingly distracted)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It's 4:30 PM. Do you need any help finding your way out?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (stands up, still looking around the room) Oh, no, I'm good. I just need to... (pauses, looks at the therapist's calendar on the wall) Wait, what day is today? I could've sworn it was Wednesday... (starts to get up and walk towards the door) Do you have a copy of the schedule for this week somewhere? I need to make sure I'm not missing anything...

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It's okay, I can look it up for you. Is there anything else that you need help with?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (shrugs) No, that's it. Thanks for listening, I guess. (starts to walk towards the door, then turns back) Oh, and can you remind me where I parked my car? I don't remember...

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Sure, I can do that. Is there anything else that I can do to help?
